data.body:
AC2 VERIFIED across the eight merged consolidation children, and its stated CHECK does not survive contact with the work - the same failure mode as AC3, so both need the same kind of correction.

AC2 says: 'checked by git diff --stat origin/main -- tests/ of each landed change showing only additions.' Six of eight are clean by that literal test (1cf6, 4329, 111a, 7931, 4cee, 7e0d). Two are not, and in BOTH cases the deletions are the consolidation doing its job:

25b4 deletes lines across 14 pre-existing test files. Inspected: they are the duplicated subprocess nested-pytest launch blocks ('import subprocess / sys; child_basetemp = ...; cp = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", ...])') being replaced by 'from _nested_pytest import nested_basetemp, run_nested_pytest'. Removing those copies IS the story. No assertion was touched.

6f18 deletes 22 lines in its own new test_store_paths.py (a second commit revising the first's file), plus -1 in test_compact_trigger.py and -6 in test_enrich_queue.py. Inspected: the compact_trigger edit is a SETUP line (os.makedirs(compact_trigger._rebar_dir(tracker)) -> os.makedirs(StorePaths(tracker).rebar_dir)), not an assertion. The enrich_queue edit IS an assertion - 'assert os.path.dirname(marker) == D._rebar_dir(tracker)' became '== StorePaths(tracker).rebar_dir' - but it asserts the SAME property and had no choice: that test existed to pin two implementations of the tracker->.rebar convention in lockstep, and the consolidation deleted one of them, so the assertion necessarily re-points at the surviving owner. The child recorded exactly that in the test's docstring.

So no PINNED observable behaviour changed anywhere - AC2's INTENT holds for all eight. What fails is its PROXY: 'only additions in tests/' is unsatisfiable for a consolidation whose whole purpose is deleting duplicated test-side copies and re-pointing references at the new owner.

RECOMMENDATION, together with the AC3 one already recorded: restate AC2 as what it means - no pre-existing test's ASSERTED PROPERTY changes; a reference re-pointed at the consolidated owner, or a duplicated helper block removed, is expected and must be recorded by the child (as 6f18 and 25b4 both did). Keep 'additions only' as a review heuristic, not a gate. Both AC2 and AC3 were written before any child had landed, and both measure a proxy that correct consolidation work legitimately violates; neither is evidence the work is wrong.
